label: Голова
description: A 10-sentence usage card for голова with health, position, and case usage.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Basic health statement. 1. 'Голова' is the body noun under focus. 2. 'Болит' is a high-value everyday verb. 3. The sentence is short and immediately useful.
Strategic focus: Possession plus condition. 1. 'У меня' frames the symptom naturally. 2. 'Голова' stays the key noun. 3. This is the standard Russian way to report a headache.
Strategic focus: Motion of the head. 1. 'Голову' appears in accusative. 2. 'Поднял' is a practical past action. 3. The line is very common in narrative typing.
Strategic focus: Simple body motion. 1. 'Склонить голову' is a natural expression. 2. The noun stays central and concrete. 3. This sentence is good for physical description and story language.
Strategic focus: Location on the body. 1. 'На голове' gives a very common placement phrase. 2. 'Шапка' is a useful everyday noun. 3. This is a vivid, simple household sentence.
Strategic focus: Spatial relation above. 1. 'Над головой' is a common prepositional phrase. 2. 'Свет' makes the sentence concrete. 3. This is useful for environment and room descriptions.
Strategic focus: Direct action on the body. 1. 'Чешу' is a simple first-person verb. 2. 'Голову' remains the object of the action. 3. The sentence is natural and easy to type.
Strategic focus: Abstract content in the head. 1. 'В голове' is a very common Russian phrase. 2. 'Идея' links body and thought. 3. This sentence is useful for everyday metaphor and thought language.
Strategic focus: Adjective agreement. 1. 'Большая' matches the feminine noun. 2. The phrase is direct and easy to picture. 3. This is a clean adjective+noun training line.

Strategic focus: Instrumental-style descriptive phrase. 1. 'С поднятой головой' is a natural image. 2. The sentence adds attitude and posture. 3. It is a strong bridge between body nouns and expressive language.
